scanDates.rule: use the already frozen last actual TWSE session for each month

historyBoundary.cohortEffectiveFrom: Controls whether a membership episode belongs to a scan-date cohort only.
historyBoundary.valuationHistoryStart: Use official listingDate when known; otherwise firstTradingDate fallback; never clamp old-company valuation history to the 2023 research cohort start.
historyBoundary.symbolReuse: History must stay inside the active listing episode; pre-episode observations cannot leak across reused symbols.

percentileWindows.currentObservation: The scan-date value is included in the valid history sample when known.
percentileWindows.minimumHistory: 252/756/1260 exact valid counts; expanding requires at least 252 valid observations.

currentValueCrosscheck.rule: Daily archive scan-date PE/PB observation presence and numeric value must exactly match raw-v0.2 for every cohort symbol.

requiredPerMember: fiscal-transition state where source provides it
invariants: every cohort member appears exactly once per scan date
PE UNKNOWN does not suppress PB
later corrections/current values cannot backfill earlier replay states
structural breaks are context tags, not automatic history resets
true expanding requires complete archive manifest; truncated expanding is prohibited
